Diploma in 3D Modelling and Animation

Faculty of Creative Multimedia (FCM)

(R/0211/4/0169) 05/27 (MQA/SWA8497)

This two-and-a-half-year program is dedicated to developing knowledge and skills that integrate academic studies with a diverse array of creative 3D animation tools and new media technology. The syllabus is designed to enable students to complete 3D animation projects that not only showcase their skills but also contribute to building a professional portfolio, preparing them for a seamless transition into the industry workforce.

  • Entry Requirements
      1. Pass SPM/O-Level or its equivalent with a minimum of Grade C in at least three (3) subjects; OR
      2. Pass UEC with a minimum of Grade B in at least three (3) subjects; OR
      3. Pass STPM or its equivalent with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in at least one (1) subject; OR
      4. Pass STAM with Grade Maqbul (Pass); OR
      5. Recognised Creative Multimedia Certificate or its equivalent; OR
      6. Recognised related Technical and Vocational Certificate or its equivalent with one (1) year relevant work experience or one (1) trimester bridging programme; OR
      7. Pass SKM Level 3 or any qualifications equivalent to Certificate (Level 3, MQF) in a related field; OR
      8. Posses an APEL.A certificate from MQA for admission into Diploma programmes; AND
      9. Pass an interview OR submission of student’s portfolio, to be determined by MMU as required.
